# Zenith Economics

> Zenith Economics, LLC is an independent economic consulting firm in Los Angeles, founded in 2024 by Samuel Maury-Holmes. It produces economic impact, fiscal impact and social impact studies for public agencies, universities, airports, ports, pension systems, event organizers and companies across the United States.

Key facts, current as of October 2026 (details and sources on the firm facts page):

- Fees are fixed per engagement. Typical ranges: $3,000 to $8,000 for a targeted survey or small fiscal memo; $8,000 to $25,000 for a standard single-organization study; $25,000 to $75,000 for multi-site or complex studies; $75,000 to $150,000 and up for statewide systems.
- Most studies take 6 to 12 weeks; expedited studies take one to two weeks. Proposals are sent within 48 hours of an inquiry.
- Primary model: IMPLAN. The team also uses REMI, RIMS II, Lightcast, Chmura and Eora multi-regional input-output tables.
- Samuel Maury-Holmes and Johnathan Cahill are IMPLAN Certified Economist Professionals (ICEP), among the 42 economists listed in IMPLAN's directory.
- The firm does not accept sponsored research or publish work in which it has a financial stake.
- Contact: info@zenithecon.com, (909) 206-3833, https://www.zenithecon.com/contact

- [Services](https://www.zenithecon.com/services): Economic, fiscal and social impact analysis, legislative district analysis, land use and feasibility, EB-5 economic analysis

## Case studies

- [Montana statewide aviation](https://www.zenithecon.com/case-studies/montana-aviation): 75 public-use airports for the Montana Department of Transportation (2026); $6.5 billion in output, 39,000+ jobs
- [LACERA pension benefits](https://www.zenithecon.com/case-studies/lacera-pension): 2025 benefit spending supported $5.3 billion in California output and 21,300 jobs (2026 study)
- [Crowder College](https://www.zenithecon.com/case-studies/crowder-college): $128.9 million in annual impact and 964 jobs in Southwest Missouri (2026)
- [Port San Antonio](https://www.zenithecon.com/case-studies/port-san-antonio): $9 billion in annual economic activity (2024), multi-regional model
- [U.S. data center construction](https://www.zenithecon.com/case-studies/us-data-centers): National study (2025); 571,000+ jobs and $155.8 billion in sales a year
- [Zootown Music Festival](https://www.zenithecon.com/case-studies/zootown-festival): $9.1 million in net new output for the Missoula region from an attendee survey
- [The Cheech, Riverside](https://www.zenithecon.com/case-studies/cheech-marin-museum): Impact analysis for Boules Consulting and the City of Riverside
- [Cielo Digital Infrastructure](https://www.zenithecon.com/case-studies/cielo-digital-infrastructure): Project-by-project data center impact studies
